questions.question: Ramappa Temple is dedicated to which God?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Shiva**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Ramappa Temple, **also known as the **Ramalingeswara Temple, is dedicated to Lord Shiva.**
 
• The temple is located in the village of **Palampet, Venkatapur Mandal, in the Mulugu district of the Indian state of Telangana.**
 
• The **Ramappa Temple** is a **remarkable example of Kakatiya architectural style, named after the sculptor Ramappa who built it, as per the instructions of the general Recherla Rudra during the Kakatiya rule in 1213 AD.**
 
• It's known for its** intricate carvings and exquisite sculpture, featuring themes from Hindu mythology, epic narratives, and folklore.**
 
• The temple's notable elements include its **sandstone sculptures, floating bricks, intricate carvings, and a dancing hall with unique pillars.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: Which of the following islands is a UNESCO world heritage site that has a collection of cave temples predominantly dedicated to the Hindu god Shiva?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Elephanta Island.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Elephanta Caves are a UNESCO World Heritage Site and a collection of cave temples predominantly dedicated to the Hindu god Shiva.

 
 
• They are on Elephanta Island, or Gharapuri, in Mumbai Harbour, 10 kilometres east of Mumbai in the Indian state of Mahārāshtra.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ellora is a UNESCO World Heritage Site located in the Aurangabad district of Maharashtra, India.

 
 
• It is one of the world's largest rock-cut monastery-temple cave complexes, featuring Hindu, Buddhist, and Jain monuments, and artwork, dating from the 600–1000 CE period.
 
 
 
• The Ajanta Caves are approximately 30 rock-cut Buddhist cave monuments that date from the 2nd century BCE to about 480 CE in the Shambha Ji Nagar district of Maharashtra state of India.
 
 
• The caves include paintings and rock-cut sculptures described as among the finest surviving examples of ancient Indian art, particularly expressive paintings that present emotions through gesture, pose, and form.

questions.question: Which of the following temples is located in Sri Lanka?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Munneswaram.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Munneswaram temple is a Hindu temple complex in Sri Lanka.
 
• The temple is one of the ancient Pancha Ishwarams dedicated to Shiva in the region.
 
• it is a collection of five temples, including a Buddhist temple.
 
• The central temple dedicated to Shiva (Siva) is the most prestigious and biggest and is popular amongst Hindus.
 
• The other temples are dedicated to Ganesha, Aiyanar and Kali.
 
• Munneswaram temple is situated in Munneswaram village, the centre of the spiritual and religious life of the people dwelling in a medieval administrative division called Munneswaram Pattuva. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Preah Vihear** is an ancient Khmer temple that was constructed during the period of the Khmer Empire.

 
 
• It is situated on the top of a 525-metre cliff in the Dângrêk Mountains, in the Preah Vihear province of** Cambodia.**
 
 
 
• **Katas Raj** also known as **Qila Katas** is a temple located in the **Punjab **province of **Pakistan.**
 
 
• **​**it is a complex of several Hindu temples connected to one another by walkaways.
 
 
 
• **Pashupatinath Temple** is located in **Kathmandu, Nepal.**
 
 
• **​**It is a Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiv.
 
• It was classified as World Heritage Site in 1979.

questions.question: The Rajarajeshwara temple at Thanjavur is dedicated to:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Lord Shiva__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Shiva temple known as Rajarajeshwara is situated near Taliparamba in Kerala's Kannur district.
 
• The temple is one of the 108 old Shiva temples that still stand in ancient Kerala.
 
• It occupies a prominent position among South India's numerous Shiva temples.
 
• Among the temples of the era, it had the tallest shikhara.
 
• The top of the Rajarajeshwara temple weighs roughly 90 tonnes. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Hindu god Shiva has a temple named after him called the Rajarajeshvara temple.
 
• The temple, which was built during the Chola era under Rajaraja and is situated in Thanjavur in the south Indian state of Tamil Nadu, is well-known for its exquisite structure.
 
• As per Tamil Nadu Hindu Endowments Board, there are 38,615 temples.
 
 
• Most of the largest Hindu temples reside here.
 
• Studded with complex architecture, a variety of sculptures, and rich inscriptions, the temples remain the very essence of the culture and heritage of Tamil land with historical records dating back to at least 3,000 years.
 
• Ex:- Karpaka Vinayakar Temple, Ucchi Pillayar Temple, Manakula Vinayagar Temple, Manimoortheeswaram Temple, Sri Poyyamozhi Vinayagar Temple etc.

questions.question: Which of the following is a temple in Mangaluru, dedicated to an avatar of Lord Shiva?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kadri Manjunatha Temple.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kadri Manjunatha Temple is a historic temple in Mangalore in the state of Karnataka, India dedicated to Lord Shiva.**
 
• **Kadri Manjunatheshwara temple is one of the ancient historical temples dating back to about 1068 A.D.**
 
• The Manjunatha temple, Kadri belongs to the **Vijayanagara style of structure.**
 
• **The earliest reference to this place is in the epigraph dated A.D.968 engraved on the pedestal of the famous Lokeshwara image**.
 
• It is mentioned that** King Kundavarma of the Alupa Dynasty installed the image in Kadarika Vihara. From this, we can know that Kadarika is the earliest form of this place's name.**
 
• **Vihara is the name given in Buddhlet settlement **while Buddhism flourished here during 10th century A.D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mukteshvara Temple**

 
 
• **​Mukteshwara Temple is a 10th-century Hindu temple dedicated to Shiva located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India**.
 
• The temple dates back to 950–975 CE and is a monument of importance in the study of the development of Hindu temples in Odisha.
 
• **The Mukteshwar temple is believed to be one of the 18 important Shiva temples.**
 
 
 
• **Ananta Vasudeva Temple​**
 
 
• **Ananta Vasudeva Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to Krishna, an avatar of Vishnu located in Bhubaneswar, the state capital of Odisha, India.**
 
• The temple was **constructed in the thirteenth century, and the complete murtis of Krishna, Balarama, and Subhadra** are worshipped there.
 
 
 
• **Gundicha Temple ****​**
 
 
• **​Gundicha Temple is a Hindu temple, situated in the temple town of Puri in the state of Odisha, India.**
 
• It is **significant for being the destination of the celebrated annual Rath Yatra of Puri.**

questions.question: Which among the following famous temples is located in Assam?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamakhya Temple.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kamakhya Temple:-**

 
 
• **The Kamakhya Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to the goddess Kamakhya, located on the Nilachal Hill in Guwahati, Assam, India. **
 
• It is one of the oldest and most revered centers of Tantric practices.
 
• It is considered to be one of the 51 Shakti Peethas, or "seats of power," associated with the goddess Shakti.
 
• The temple is believed to be the place where the yoni, or womb, of the goddess Sati fell after she was immolated on the funeral pyre of her husband, the god Shiva.
 
• The yoni is represented by a natural spring that flows from a cave within the temple complex. This spring is known as the Kamakhya Gupha, or "Kamakhya Cave," and is said to have healing powers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Somnath Temple:-

 
 
• It​ is located in Gujarat and is one of the 12 Jyotirlinga shrines dedicated to Lord Shiva.
 
 
 
• Shore Temple:-
 
 
• It​ is located in Mahabalipuram, Tamil Nadu and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its Dravidian architecture.
 
 
 
• Mundeshwari Temple:-
 
 
• It​ is located in Bihar and is one of the oldest Hindu temples in India.
 
 

86:T

questions.question: The popular style of temple architecture in northern India is called ________.
questions.solution:
Correct Answer **Nagara**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Northern India saw a rise in the popularity of temple architecture in the Nagara style.
 
• It typically lacks ornate boundary walls or entrances.
 
• The tallest tower is always exactly beneath the garbhagriha.
 
• There is an installation of Amalaka or Kalash on Shikhara.
 
• Nagara temples can be divided into many different types according to the shikhara's shape:
 
 
• Valabhi: Temples built in the Valabhi style are rectangular and have barrel-vaulted roofs.
 
• Wagon vaulted buildings and constructions get their name from having a vaulted chamber roof.
 
• Phamsana: These are shorter, but wider constructions made comprised of roofs with multiple slabs that rise up in a gradual slope on a straight incline like a pyramid meeting at one point over the middle of the building.
 
• Rekha-Prasad: A straightforward Shikara with a square base and inwardly curved walls with a pointed top distinguish Rekha-Prasad or Latina temples.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The Pallavas ruled over parts of Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and northern Tamil Nadu until the ninth century.
 
• They are credited with developing the Dravidian style of temple architecture in South India.
 
• A compound wall encloses the Dravida temple.
 
• A Gopuram, or entrance doorway, is located in the middle of the front wall.
 
• The vimana, or main temple tower, is shaped like a stepped pyramid that rises up geometrically in Tamil Nadu.
 
• The word "shikhara" is only used to refer to the crowning part at the top of South Indian temples.
 
• It is typically formed like a tiny stupika or an octagonal cupola.
 
• The garbhagriha's entrance is adorned with ferocious Dvarapalas, or the doorkeepers guarding the temple.
 
• A sizable water tank is frequently found encased within the complex.
 
• There are divisions among Dravida temples. These are basically five different shapes:
 
 
• square, kuta, and also caturasra.
 
• rectangular or shala or ayatasra.
 
• elliptical, coming from wagon vaulted shapes of apsidal chaityas with a horseshoe-shaped entry facade typically known as a nasi, also known as elephant-backed or vrittayata.
 
• circular or vritta.
 
• either ashtasra or octagonal.

questions.question: The Temple at Khajuraho were built during which dynasty?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandella dynasty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Temple at Khajuraho** were built during the **Chandella dynasty.**
 
• **The Chandellas **were a **medieval Indian dynasty **that ruled over the region of **Bundelkhand in central India** from the** 9th to the 13th centuries.**
 
• **The temples at Khajuraho**, known for their **intricate carvings and architectural beauty,** were constructed during the** peak of the Chandella dynasty's reign, between the 10th and 12th centuries.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maurya dynasty**:

 
 
• **The Maurya dynasty **was an **ancient Indian dynasty that ruled from the 4th to the 2nd century BCE.**
 
• It was founded by** Chandragupta Maurya** and reached its **zenith under the reign of Ashoka the Great.**
 
• **The Maurya dynasty** is known for its political and military achievements, as well as Ashoka's conversion to Buddhism and promotion of its principles.
 
 
 
• **Nanda dynasty: **
 
 
• **The Nanda dynasty** was an **ancient Indian dynasty **that existed during the **4th century BCE.**
 
• It was founded by **Mahapadma Nanda** and was one of the **earliest historical dynasties in India.**
 
• **The Nanda dynasty **ruled over the **Magadha region **and expanded their empire through military conquests. 
 
 
 
• **Vijayanagara dynasty: **
 
 
• **The Vijayanagara Empire** was a prominent **South Indian empire** that thrived from the **14th to the 17th centuries CE.**
 
• It was founded by** Harihara I **and **Bukka Raya I **and reached its peak under the rule of **Krishnadevaraya.**
 
• **The empire **was known for its cultural and architectural achievements, including the construction of **numerous temples and monuments.**

questions.question: Brihadeeshwara Temple, also called Periya Koyil or Bi*g T*emple, is located in Thanjavur in the Indian state of:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Tamil Nadu__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Brihadeeswarar Temple also called Periya Koyil or Big Temple is the greatest architectural monument of the Chola period in **Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu.**
 
• Rajaraja Chola, who commissioned the temple, called it Rajarajeshwaram (Rajarajeswaram), literally "the temple of the almighty of Rajaraja".
 
• A later inscription in the Brihannayaki shrine calls the temple's deity Periya Udaiya Nayanar, which appears to be the source of the modern names Brihadisvara and Peruvudaiyar Kovil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Brihadeeswarar Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to Shiva on the south bank of the Cauvery river in Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• It is one of the largest Hindu temples and an exemplary example of fully realized Tamil architecture.
 
• It is called Dakshina Meru.
 
• Built by Tamil king Raja Raja Chola I between 1003 and 1010 AD, the temple is a part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site known as the "Great Living Chola Temples", along with the Chola dynasty era Gangaikonda Cholapuram temple and Airavatesvara temple that is about 70 kilometres and 40 kilometres to its northeast respectively.
